MCC 6513 (real estate agents and managers - rentals) fits the main stated activity, short-term rental of the merchant's own Airbnb property. No listing, offering or product page was found to confirm any of these activities. The merchant also says it takes bookings off the Airbnb platform, which is a known vacation-rental fraud and chargeback pattern.

Searches for OPM Property Management with scam, reviews or complaint found no reviews, news, complaints or scam reports about this business. Results concerned unrelated firms with similar names. No dated independent presence was found.

merchants.summary: No independent footprint was found for Opm Property Management LLC: no registry hit, listing, social profile, Airbnb host page or review. The CA Secretary of State register blocked automated search. The descriptor and email handle fit the name, but the contact is a free usa.com mailbox with no website, and the account is one day old. MCC 6513 fits the own-property rental activity, but the model also includes off-Airbnb direct bookings (a known fraud and chargeback pattern) and sales of consulting and 'documents'. The risk points total 0 only because every dimension is unverified; manual SOS confirmation, Airbnb listing and ownership evidence, and representative KYC are needed.

This is an individual / sole proprietor, so no state entity registration is expected. 'Pc World' does not contain the owner's surname, and per LA County guidance a sole proprietor trading under such a name must file a Fictitious Business Name Statement. The county's online FBN search could not be reached by automation, so the filing is unchecked. Nothing contradicts it. [https://laalmanac.com/_main/records_fbn_statements.php]

Searches found no Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, Nextdoor, OfferUp or BBB listing for a PC-building business called 'Pc World' in La Puente or the San Gabriel Valley. 'PC World' results all referred to the unrelated UK retailer or the magazine. This is a service business with no observable footprint.
Representative name not available to the verifier on this run.

No website was declared. The live.com email handle and the descriptor 'ERIC OCHOA' are consistent with each other, and a sole proprietor using their own name as the descriptor is common and is not a random string. Nothing refers to payment collection.

The declared activity is custom PC assembly. MCC 7299 (miscellaneous personal services) is a catch-all that can fit a labour-only build service. 7379 (computer maintenance and repair) would fit better, and 5734 or 5732 would apply if complete PCs or parts are sold. No merchant page was found to confirm the activity.
No dated reviews, listings, complaints or scam reports were found for 'Pc World' in La Puente or for the descriptor name as a PC builder.
